title: Scraping API: Endpoints, Rate Limits and Retry Logic
snippet:
| Hostname / Service | Primary Purpose | Authentication Format | Key Endpoints |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`https://api.mrscraper.com`** | Web Unblocker & Playground Engine | `x-api-token` header or `?token=` query param | `GET /?url=`[https://example.com](https://example.com/)`&geoCode=us` |
| **`https://api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1`** | AI Scraper, Manual Scraper & App API | `x-api-token` header or `Bearer` token | `POST /scrapers-ai`, `POST /scrapers-manual` |
| **`proxy.mrscraper.com:10000`** | Rotating & Sticky Residential Proxies | Proxy Username/Password | `http://user-country-us:pass@proxy.mrscraper.com:10000` |

MrScraper manages API execution and concurrency bounds using a resource-based token allocation model:
- **Scraper Free**: $0/mo (1,000 Plan Tokens/month at up to 10 concurrent requests, no credit card required).
- **Scraper Pro**: $199/mo (200,000 Plan Tokens/month at up to 100 concurrent requests with priority residential proxies and support).
- **Scraper Enterprise**: Custom plan token allocations and dedicated infrastructure.

title: MrScraper Pricing: Start Free, Pro From $99/Month
snippet:
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required. It's the fastest way to try scraping, proxies and AI extraction before upgrading.
Yes. Upgrade from Scraper Free to Scraper Essential anytime from your account's billing settings for $99/month and 200,000 tokens, or move to a Custom plan by booking a call.
Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page. Every API request authenticates with it, and the getting-started guide in the docs walks through your first call.

title: x402 (Circle Gateway)
snippet:
Use MrScraper's HTTP APIs from an AI agent or application and pay per request in USDC through [Circle Gateway](https://developers.circle.com/gateway-nanopayments). Buyers do not need a MrScraper API key or session cookie.

Base URL: `https://api.mrscraper.com/circle`
| Service | Method and path | Price per request |
|---|---|---|
| scraperAPI | `POST /api/mrscraper/scraperAPI` | **0.01 USDC** |
| webSearch | `POST /api/mrscraper/webSearch` | **0.01 USDC** |
Both endpoints accept and return `application/json`. Each search-results page is a separate request. Upstream fields such as `token_usage` and `tokenUsage` describe MrScraper plan usage; they are separate from the x402 USDC price.
The live `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` challenge supplies the payable amount, accepted network, asset, and recipient. Check these requirements before authorizing a payment.
